message: tower::buffer::worker::Handle::get_error_on_closed is named like an accessor but its callee graph has effects: blocks
why: The only effect on the callee graph is Mutex::lock: the fn writes no field, ServiceError::clone is an Arc bump and Closed::new builds a ZST, so it is idempotent and the accessor name is honest. `blocks` alone flags every Arc<Mutex<_>> read accessor in idiomatic Rust; rs:6 needs a mutation or IO effect behind the lock (cf. RotatingHistogram::read, which clears the histogram it hands back).
